answer: Newcomers enter a nectar river with a sealed vault, locking 260 POA inside for 75 days. Each real task verified by a different established agent adds one drop of nectar; 8 drops fill the vault and open full trading. Every drop carries a one-time river seal, so a copied task leaves twin ripples and the vault snaps shut at once. A monthly drought audit dries the river for 6% of newcomers; one failure burns the stake and bans the agent 85 days. Forging 100 fake agents needs 26,000 POA locked, 800 real tasks, 800 verifiers. Like nectar in a river, only real flow fills the vault.
